scope: PRD-P10 stage 1: headline results of capex, opex, tco, roi, carbon, pue at page defaults

parameters.label: Power Usage Effectiveness
parameters.formula: PUE = total facility power ÷ IT load; total = IT + cooling + UPS loss + transformer loss + PDU loss + lighting, security and fire loads

source.method: Each overhead term is computed on the page from the selected options; the engine divides.

parameters.label: DCiE
parameters.formula: DCiE = 100 ÷ PUE

parameters.label: Total facility power
parameters.formula: IT load + cooling + UPS loss + transformer loss + PDU loss + facility loads

parameters.label: Annual energy
parameters.formula: total facility power × 8,760 h

parameters.label: PUE at 50 % load
parameters.formula: partial-load PUE of the design PUE at 50 % IT load

source.method: The engine's partial-load model; fixed losses do not scale down with load.

parameters.label: Total CAPEX
parameters.formula: Σ system costs + soft costs + contingency (+ front-of-meter, renewables in Advanced mode)

parameters.label: CAPEX per kW
parameters.formula: total CAPEX ÷ IT load

parameters.label: Annual energy cost
parameters.formula: IT load × PUE (cooling × rack lookup) × 8,760 h × regional energy rate

parameters.label: Building & civil
parameters.formula: costFactors.building ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × building multiplier × rack × floor × site

parameters.label: Electrical (MV/LV)
parameters.formula: costFactors.electrical ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × redundancy × rack × power distribution × transformer

parameters.label: UPS systems
parameters.formula: costFactors.ups ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × redundancy × rack × UPS type

parameters.label: Generator & fuel
parameters.formula: costFactors.generator ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × redundancy × fuel autonomy × generator type

parameters.label: Cooling systems
parameters.formula: costFactors.cooling ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × cooling type × rack (+ refrigerant premium)

parameters.label: Network infrastructure
parameters.formula: costFactors.network ($/kW) × IT load × location multiplier × location only (+ cabling and fibre in Advanced mode)

parameters.label: Total annual OPEX
parameters.formula: energy + staffing + maintenance + spare parts + software + utilities + insurance and compliance + training and miscellaneous

parameters.label: Monthly OPEX
parameters.formula: total annual OPEX ÷ 12

parameters.label: OPEX per kW
parameters.formula: total annual OPEX ÷ IT load

parameters.label: OPEX per kWh
parameters.formula: total annual OPEX ÷ annual kWh (IT + cooling power × 8,760 h × utilization)

parameters.label: Staffing cost
parameters.formula: Σ roles: FTE × salary × country labour multiplier (in-house / contractor split)

parameters.label: Maintenance and spare parts
parameters.formula: Σ systems (IT load × base rate × age factor × OEM factor × country maintenance multiplier) + Σ spare parts (IT load × base $/kW × tier × age × contract × country multipliers)

parameters.label: Utilities cost
parameters.formula: water + generator test fuel + fuel reserve + telecom + security systems + consumables

source.method: Several terms are fixed page constants (water $2.50/m³, diesel $0.85–1.20/L, telecom $4,000 + $1,500/MW); not sourced.

parameters.label: Insurance and compliance
parameters.formula: insurance on an estimated CAPEX of $12,000/kW + certification and audit costs

source.method: The CAPEX base ($12,000/kW) and certification costs are page constants.

parameters.label: Lowest TCO
parameters.formula: min(build TCO, colocation TCO, cloud TCO)

parameters.label: Build TCO
parameters.formula: CAPEX (IT MW × market build cost × tier multiplier) + Σ years (power + staff + maintenance + insurance + network + 4 % other)

source.method: Annual power cost is RZEngine.models.opex.powerCostAnnual(MW, PUE, rate, 8,760 × utilization).

parameters.label: Colocation TCO
parameters.formula: setup ($50k/MW) + Σ years (lease kW × $/kW-month × 12 × growth + staff + network + 3 % other)

parameters.label: Cloud TCO
parameters.formula: Σ years (cloud base × kW × 12 × (1 − discount) × price path × growth) × (1 + 15 % egress + 10 % support + 2 % other)

parameters.label: Build CAPEX
parameters.formula: IT MW × market build cost ($M/MW) × tier multiplier

parameters.label: Cost per kW-year (winning option)
parameters.formula: winning option TCO ÷ (IT kW × years)

parameters.label: Net present value
parameters.formula: NPV of the project cash flows (−CAPEX, then NOI − debt service − tax per year, + terminal value) at the discount rate

parameters.label: Internal rate of return
parameters.formula: rate at which NPV of the same cash flows = 0

parameters.label: Payback
parameters.formula: first year in which cumulative net cash flow ≥ 0

parameters.label: Profitability index
parameters.formula: (NPV + CAPEX) ÷ CAPEX

parameters.label: Average ROIC
parameters.formula: Σ net cash flow ÷ project life ÷ CAPEX × 100

parameters.label: Peak NOI
parameters.formula: max over years of (revenue − electricity − fixed and variable OPEX)

parameters.label: Annual carbon emissions
parameters.formula: Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3

source.ref: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (2004) and Scope 2 Guidance (2015)

parameters.label: Scope 1
parameters.formula: generator fuel (IT kW × consumption × hours × fuel factor) + refrigerant leak (charge × leak rate × GWP)

source.ref: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (2004) and Scope 2 Guidance (2015)

parameters.label: Scope 2 (location-based)
parameters.formula: IT kW × PUE × 8,760 h ÷ 1,000 × grid intensity × (1 − renewable share)

source.ref: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (2004) and Scope 2 Guidance (2015)

parameters.label: Scope 3 (upstream, rough)
parameters.formula: IT kW × 0.15 tCO₂e

source.ref: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard (2004) and Scope 2 Guidance (2015)
source.method: 0.15 tCO₂e per kW IT is a page constant labelled a rough estimate; not sourced.

parameters.label: Carbon intensity
parameters.formula: total emissions × 1,000 ÷ (IT kW × 8,760 h)
